editorial:
Imagine a quiet town where everything looks perfect on the outside, but everyone is hiding a dark secret. That is exactly where you land in this mystery. You follow the story of Dario, a pilot for the rich and powerful Canevari family, who ends up dead along with two girls at a house by the river. The vibe is very tense because the town is terrified of the powerful family in charge. You get to ride along with Emilio Girotti, a prosecutor who has to fight through a wall of silence to find the truth. It feels like a classic detective story where the underdog takes on the big bosses.

What really works here is the slow build of the mystery and how the town tries to block the investigation. The acting is solid and keeps you wondering who is lying. While the pacing is a bit slower than a modern action flick, it gives you time to soak in the drama. If you love mysteries where the detective has to play by his own rules, you will enjoy this. Since it is an older TV movie, you might want to look for it on a 4K Blu-ray for your collection or see if it is available for rent on Apple TV to get the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover that the murders were not random. The powerful Canevari family tried to cover up their crimes to protect their reputation. Girotti finally breaks the silence of the locals and finds the proof that links the family to the poisoning. The twist reveals that greed and family pride led to the deaths. The movie wraps up with the truth coming out and the guilty people finally facing the law.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves small-town murder mysteries and detective stories.
